Episode 146. The Chaos Awakened
Before the second battle began, the black knights that Rosa sent to inform Siron about the situation couldn't meet him.
Even if they were to arrive as quickly as possible, reaching the deep black sea in two days was impossible, and above all,
Siron's expeditionary force had already entered the territory of the Five Kings of the Black Sea. It meant complete isolation from the outside world.
The territory of the Five Kings of the Black Sea was not a land belonging to the human world, but a huge subspace prepared for them.
The sun does not rise, and no shadows or footprints are left on the black land. It was just endless darkness, indistinguishable whether it was day or night.
The only things to eat were occasionally monsters, or more precisely, the 'remnants of chaos', that jumped out of the darkness and attacked the party.
Siron, Luna, the veterans and active black knights, and the monster of many legends, were walking on that deep and black land.
"Ah, these tasteless and unappetizing creatures. Knights! Dinner is ready, I've tried to cook it well, but given the ingredients, the taste is... Oh, I'm sorry. Please don't hit me!"
Ozodok was hunched over in an exaggerated manner, rotating a bowl filled with monster food (made with Ozodok's ability).
Of course, after Ozodok was captured alive, he was somewhat assaulted by the knights and Toven.
But since then, he had behaved well and was rarely beaten, and thanks to Siron acknowledging his usefulness, he was recognized as a member of the expeditionary force.

Although not complete, Ozodok's memory of the Black Sea was clearly helping the expedition a lot. If he hadn't been there, it would have taken more time to find the territory of the Five Kings of the Black Sea.
Therefore, Ozodok was now joking. Unfortunately, no one responded to his pitiful jokes, trying to lighten the mood somehow.
"Haha, enjoy your meal!"
Ozodok stood up, scratching the back of his head awkwardly. Luna and the knights sat down and silently chewed their share. The sound was like a beast gnawing a wild animal to the bone.
'Ugh... I can't breathe. How many days has this atmosphere been going on? Damn it.'
Ozodok swallowed a sigh, watching them eat.
He didn't eat the food he made. From the beginning, unless it was gold, food didn't mean much to him.
But there was another important reason why Ozodok didn't eat monsters.
The remnants of chaos.
After entering the territory of the Five Kings of the Black Sea, he had been thinking about the energy called 'Chaos'. Ozodok was slowly regaining his old memories.
'Once Chaos sticks to life in any form, it never falls off. Until the subject becomes a completely mad monster....'
Temar Run Kandel.
Here is the translation in English:
A thousand years ago, even the head of the Runcandel family had become a monster consumed by chaos, he remembered hearing such rumors.
Chaos was a power to be avoided by anyone who was a living being, not just humans.

'They all must have already accumulated quite a bit of chaotic energy. I hope they don't go crazy and kill me. Looking at them eating and fighting without any problems, it seems like they are still okay for now...!'
All Ozdok could do was to keep an eye out, praying that such a thing would not happen. Luna and the knights, as he thought, had no spare time to push away the chaos accumulating within themselves.
In this land, one could survive only by struggling against chaos every moment, even without a battle.

[Hmm! But I'm a bit worried about this Ozdok. Since the day before yesterday, there have been no monsters attacking, so food could become a problem. This is a problem, we can't even go out and find some.]
"Ozdok."
[Oh my goodness!]
The reason Ozdok was so surprised was that it was Shiron who had called him.
Since entering the territory of the 5 Kings, the expedition had all become quieter as they all had to fight off the energy of chaos, but Shiron was especially so.
He seldom voiced even simple commands or orders. He seemed almost inhuman.
[Ah, such impertinence. I apologize, elder.]
"You are doing very well."
Ozdok could only widen his eyes in surprise at Shiron's unexpected response.
Not knowing how to respond, he bowed his head as if paying respect. In his life of about two thousand years, there had probably never been a more significant event.
'Did, did I just receive a compliment!? From the elder, to me, Ozdok!'
Shiron truly thought that Ozdok was doing well.
In this horrific domain, incessantly joking, casually cooking using monster corpses, sometimes humming a tune to himself.
Preserving the universal emotions of a sentient being, as it were, was impossible for a 'human'. Ozdok's actions were of great help to the knights in pushing away chaos.
They were being reminded not to forget. The emotions of a human.
'When I return, I should give a more generous reward to the youngest.'
Shiron's gaze reached the darkness beyond.

The worry about food that Ozdok voiced because no monsters were visible, and the fact that his daughter and the knights had been focusing their minds without uttering even short words in the past few days.
All of it had a reason in the direction his gaze was heading.
The Five Kings of the Black Sea.
The time was approaching to finally face one of them.
"Luna."
"Yes, Father."
"The battle will begin soon. If you can't stand it, hide behind my back."
Luna knew very well that her father, Shiron, was the one most affected by this terrible chaos. Not just her, but all the knights knew it.
Unlike the others, Shiron had been fighting chaos even before entering this void, and it was an area that Luna and the knights couldn't even imagine.
For the first time.
Luna felt pity for her father. Or perhaps, she might have been feeling sorry for him for a long time.
After coming to this land, she was beginning to understand her father, and herself who was looking at him, little by little.
"I'll try to make sure that doesn't happen."
At Luna's response, Shiron gave a faint smile.
The knights put down their bowls. And they moved towards Shiron, patting Ozdok's head or shoulder as they passed by.
And then, as if they had been waiting.
The darkness entering the expedition's field of view darkened further, and Ozdok had no choice but to slump down. His legs had given out.
'Ah, the King of the Black Sea...!'
One of the Five Kings of the Black Sea.
One of them was revealing a great chaos towards the expedition. Ozdok couldn't even breathe under the pressure, but all the knights stood firm, facing it head-on.
Shrrr...
Varisada slowly came out of its sheath. The chaos that was rushing in like a tsunami stopped at the sight of the light starting to spread from it.
Shiron was the only one in the expedition who had fought directly with the kings of the Black Sea.
He knew who the numerous eyes beyond the darkness, looking down on him and the expedition, represented.
"Kial, it's you."
Kial.
The name of the first king of the Black Sea the expedition faced. Soon, thousands, or perhaps tens of thousands of eyes, all focused on Shiron alone.
"Shiron Runcandel. You've managed to come this far, leading that heavy destiny..."
A dark and chilling voice echoed throughout the void.

The monsters from the deepest part of the Black Sea they've been dealing with so far, and the remnants of chaos they've killed in the void, were nothing but dust compared to Kial. These are monsters that sometimes even gave Luna and the previous black knights a hard time.
Shiron didn't respond, but slowly moved towards Kial. Every time he took a step, the pressure of chaos that had been pressing down on the expedition was pushed back towards Kial.
"Judging by the mood, it seems you didn't come to accept the offer we made back then."
The offer, Kial and the other kings of the Black Sea wanted Shiron to become a being like them.
"Do you want to meet the same fate as your ancestors?"
"Then or now, my job is to cut you guys down, not to become a fragment of a broken object."
The Primordial Stone.
The Five Kings of the Black Sea are all fragments of the shattered Primordial Stone. And the Kings of the Black Sea could not be close to each other unless under special circumstances.
This was because the will of the gods who shattered the Primordial Stone still remained.

So, what the Kings of the Black Sea wanted was only one thing, a mediator who could combine them without any constraints again. A person who could sever the will of the gods that remained like a stigma.
It was someone like Shiron.
"You should know better than anyone that your wishes cannot be fulfilled, foolish..."
Suddenly, Kial stopped speaking, blinking his eyes. He seemed to be greatly flustered by something.
Not only that, but Shiron also seemed taken aback. He felt the same sensation as Kial.
What they simultaneously realized was the fact that another King of the Black Sea had awakened.
Not in this void, but in the world.
Soon, Shiron's face twisted, and Kial narrowed his eyes, letting out a gloomy laugh.
"Finally... I found it. It was outside, my brother, Glyiek!"
Glyiek, Kial, Nirgand, Su, Morganiel.
Of the Five Kings of the Black Sea, Shiron had never met Glyiek in person, and the Kings did not know the whereabouts of Glyiek either.
He was the white stone of Hyran.
The fifth piece of the Primordial Stone.
Shiron swung his sword at Kial, who was showing joy, and he was cut, yet he still cried out in joy.
Pazuzu-soon-! Chichiching...!
The first sight Jin and his party saw as soon as they entered the fortress was the incredibly massive and solid ice covering Dante's seal and the entire interior.
And it was a sight of it being brutally shattered by some dark force.
Talarris had defended the fortress since the beginning of the second battle, but even she couldn't prevent the seal of chaos from breaking.
"Miss Talarris!"
"Begonia!"

Blood was running from the corner of Talarris's mouth, who had fallen towards the party. The black power released from the seal was spreading everywhere without any sign of stopping even after overcoming the power of ice.
The fortress that Ron and Hyran's knights had so strenuously defended disappeared without a trace in an instant.
At that moment, Jin couldn't help but remember what Talarris had said.

-In some ways... it might be a blessing that Zipul's main body is coming, and Runcandel is waiting nearby. If the chaos of the white stone awakens, whether they like it or not, they have to fight it. If not us and them, no one else can stop it anyway.
